'''Domeille''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She has gray hair, lean with a thrusting chin. She has a scar on the side of her face.

== Activities ==
She is one of the Maidens who guards [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].
